questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion for emphasis in a conditional clause?
options: If she had known the truth, she would have left immediately.
Had she known the truth, she would have left immediately.
She would have left immediately if she had known the truth.
She left immediately because she had known the truth.
questions.answer: Had she known the truth, she would have left immediately.

questions.question: Which cleft sentence correctly restructures the following sentence to highlight the subject? 'The reason he failed the exam was his lack of preparation.'
options: It was his lack of preparation that he failed the exam because of.
It was his lack of preparation that he failed the exam due to.
The reason he failed the exam was preparation that he lacked.
It was preparation he lacked that caused him to fail the exam.
questions.answer: It was preparation he lacked that caused him to fail the exam.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical scenario involving a past event?
options: She wished she was taller.
She wished she were taller.
She wished to be taller.
She wished to be as tall as she used to be.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates correct use of ellipsis in a complex, formal context?
options: She said, ‘I’ll be back soon.’ She didn’t mention the time she’d leave.
She said, ‘I’ll be back soon.’ She left without saying when.
She left soon after saying she’d be back, omitting the time.
She said, ‘I’ll be back,’ but didn’t include the time—just the fact.
questions.answer: She said, ‘I’ll be back soon.’ She left without saying when.

questions.question: Which sentence best demonstrates the use of a formal register with a nuanced choice of verb to express a subtle distinction in advice?
options: You should consider taking this job to improve your skills.
You must take this job to improve your skills.
You might as well take this job to improve your skills.
You could take this job if you wanted to improve your skills.
questions.answer: You should consider taking this job to improve your skills.
